notes: Supplier opening balances (debit and credit menu entries, AP types with TRNS_TYPE 5): header checks, line checks and derivations, generated supplier transaction (VN_MAINTRNS, + VN_SUBTRNS invoice line for a credit balance) and supplier balance fields per line, delete / change rules (APP_RULES3_VN).

rules.where: TRNS_ID in (select ID from VN_TRNSTYPE where TRNS_TYPE = 5) and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or TRNS_ID in (select TRNS_ID from VN_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD where FLAG = 1 and PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

row_rules.VN_MAINTRNS_OP: if app_rules3_vn.is_form('VNTRN_OP') then app_rules3_vn.op_mast_row(inserting, :new.trns_id, :new.trns_serial, :new.trns_date, :new.doc_no, :new.description_a, :new.description_e, :old.trns_id, :old.trns_serial); end if;
row_rules.VN_SUBTRNS_OP: if app_rules3_vn.is_form('VNTRN_OP') then app_rules3_vn.op_line_row(inserting, :new.trns_id, :new.trns_serial, :new.bill_seq, :new.supplier_id, :new.bill_id1, :new.bill_id2, :new.total_value, :new.currency_code, :new.currency_rate, :new.sales_man, :new.pay_type_code, :new.r_trns_serial, :old.supplier_id, :old.bill_id1, :old.bill_id2, :old.total_value, :old.currency_code, :old.currency_rate, :old.pay_type_code, :old.r_trns_serial); end if;

info.name: TOT
info.sql: select to_char(sum(total_value), 'FM999G999G999G990D00') from vn_subtrns_op where trns_id = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_ID) and trns_serial = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_SERIAL)

info.name: TOTR
info.sql: select to_char(sum(total_value * nvl(currency_rate, 1)), 'FM999G999G999G990D00') from vn_subtrns_op where trns_id = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_ID) and trns_serial = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_SERIAL)

info.name: EFF
info.sql: select max(case effect when 0 then app_rules3_vn.msg('مدين', 'Debit') when 1 then app_rules3_vn.msg('دائن', 'Credit') end) from vn_trnstype where id = to_number(:PAGE_TRNS_ID)
